scope.statement: For a finite edge-to-edge planar complex of unit rhombi with every edge incident to one or two faces, prove V=R+B/2+chi and n=R+B/2+chi+t, so the exact shell correction is t+chi-1=t+k-h-1.
scope.domain: Finite edge-to-edge subsets of the unit rhombic parallelogram tiling; exact integer incidence, Euler, component, hole, and source-count identities.
scope.limitations: Does not prove the geometric shell lower bound, a multi-grain/interface transfer, source extraction, global optimality, or any Level I conclusion.

result: Independent reconstruction of Target B equation (36.2)'s exact topology-sensitive count identity; reproduced on disk, annulus, disconnected, and outside-label controls.
remaining_questions: Prove G+E >= (sqrt(3)/4)B + (sqrt(3)/2)(t+k-h-1) for the canonical source across grains, interfaces, holes, and outside labels, or construct a full source-preserving strict sub-D competitor.
